claims.statement: On the completed fleet02/B20 P2 packet Z>1/768 and E2(D)>1/48, if the order-3/order-2 mixture Omega=(1/4)w3+(3/4)v2 has all row marginals at most 1/2 (or after transposition), then the full ambient quadratic form has a bounded continuous density with norm <72.220.

For a physical-minor law Omega of mean order kbar, if rho*alpha_i<=1/2 for every row and rho*kbar>2, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 rho kbar sqrt(e)/(rho kbar-2) * K_rho^(-1/(2 rho kbar))*K(Omega)^(-1/(2 kbar)), with continuous density.

For lambda=1/32 and rho=493/500, the fleet02/B20 P2 state is paid by ||p_Q||_infinity<5902 whenever the fractional mixed row gate holds; in particular max natural pair-volume row marginal <=0.49 suffices, and the same holds for columns by transposition.

If both fractional mixed orientations fail, there are fixed residual row/column anchors for which either the anchored 2x2 determinant bank in D or the anchored 3x3 determinant bank in B has total squared-minor mass >14/69513.
Pay either fixed two-anchor deshear reserve ||dC-cr^T||_F^2>14/69513 or ||det(P)C-V adj(P)U||_F^2>14/69513 in strict N3 while retaining arbitrary same-bank curvature and ambient couplings.
